title: Customer Terms Annex — Grace Allowance on the First Analyst Overage Charges, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Grace Allowance on the First Analyst Overage Charges

Annex to the customer terms of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions fixing the grace allowance set against the chargeable hours when analyst work beyond the pool is invoiced. The opening grace allowance is 2.0 hours; the repeat grace allowance is 1.0 hour.

## Terms

Where no charge for analyst hours beyond the pool has ever been invoiced on the subscription and the subscription stands active, the opening grace allowance is set against the chargeable hours. Where exactly one such charge has already been invoiced on the subscription, the repeat grace allowance is set against them. Where two or more such charges have already been invoiced on the subscription, no grace allowance is set against the chargeable hours.

## Schedule

| Analyst overage charges already on the subscription's invoice history | Subscription status | Grace allowance |
|---|---|---|
| none | active | 2.0 hours |
| none | any status other than active | none |
| exactly one | any | 1.0 hour |
| two or more | any | none |

The count is of charge lines of the analyst overage kind on the subscription's invoice history, over its whole life; charges of any other kind — subscription fees, meter fees, late fees, reinstatement fees — are not counted.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A subscription whose ledger shows one analyst overage charge from an earlier year has 6.75 hours beyond the pool; the repeat allowance of 1.0 hour leaves 5.75 chargeable hours. Had the ledger shown no such charge and the subscription stood active, the opening allowance of 2.0 hours would leave 4.75; had it shown two, all 6.75 hours would be chargeable.
